name: ManageX – Pre-Orders, Product Badges, Buy Now, Quick View, Advanced Cart and More for WooCommerce
author: SoftTent

sections.description:
ManageX is a comprehensive WooCommerce enhancement plugin that combines 18+ essential extensions into one powerful suite. Eliminate plugin bloat, improve site performance, and save money while providing your customers with an exceptional shopping experience.

Key Features

Conversion & Checkout Optimization

  • Buy Now – Skip the cart page and send customers directly to checkout for faster purchases. Reduce cart abandonment with one-click checkout functionality.

  • Quick View – Let customers preview product details instantly in a modal without leaving shop pages. Faster browsing leads to higher conversion rates.

  • Sticky Add to Cart – Keep the purchase button always visible as users scroll. Never miss a sale due to hidden call-to-action buttons.

  • Floating Add to Cart – A persistent floating add-to-cart button that follows users as they browse, ensuring the purchase option is always one click away.

  • Side Cart Button – Quick access to cart from any page with a floating side cart button. Reduce friction in the buying journey.

  • Footer Cart – Display a persistent cart summary bar at the bottom of the screen with real-time updates. Keep customers informed about their cart contents.

Marketing & Visual Merchandising

  • Product Badges – Display eye-catching labels (Sale, New, Hot Deal, Best Seller, Featured, Low Stock) to grab attention and highlight promotions. Fully customizable designs with image overlay support.

  • Trust Badges – Build credibility with security seals, guarantee icons, and trust signals. Increase customer confidence at critical decision points.

  • Free Shipping Badge – Automatically display “Free Shipping” badges on qualifying products. Encourage higher order values with smart free shipping indicators.

  • Payment Logos – Showcase accepted payment methods and security certifications. Reduce checkout friction by showing payment options upfront.

Product Management

  • Pre-Orders – Accept orders for out-of-stock or upcoming products. Features include:
    • Support for simple and variable products
    • Custom preorder pricing (full, partial, or free)
    • Availability date management with automatic status updates
    • Stock management and automated order processing
    • Customizable button text and styling
    • Email notifications for balance payments

User Experience & Navigation

  • Search from Anywhere – Global search bar with real-time product results and autocomplete suggestions. Help customers find products instantly from any page.

  • Scroll to Top – Floating back-to-top button with smooth scrolling. Improve navigation on long product pages and blog posts.

  • Inactive Tab Message – Display custom messages in browser tabs when users navigate away. Reduce cart abandonment with attention-grabbing notifications.

Legal & Compliance

  • Cookies Banner – GDPR and CCPA compliant cookie consent banners. Features include:

    • Accept/Decline button options
    • Customizable styling and placement
    • Cookie expiration management
    • Multiple banner styles (bar, box, popup)
    • Mobile-responsive design

  • Allow to Terms – Add customizable terms and conditions checkboxes to checkout, registration, and product pages. Ensure legal compliance with styled, validated checkboxes.

Social Proof

  • Customer Reviews – Advanced review system with:
    • Verified buyer badges
    • Image and video uploads
    • Helpful voting system
    • Automated review request emails

Customization

  • Add to Cart Modify – Customize add-to-cart button text storewide or for specific products. Create more compelling calls-to-action.

Why Choose ManageX?

  • All-in-One Solution – Replace multiple plugins with a single, lightweight suite
  • Performance Optimized – Clean code with minimal impact on page load times
  • SEO Friendly – All extensions built with SEO best practices in mind
  • Mobile Responsive – Every feature tested and optimized for mobile devices
  • Developer Friendly – Clean codebase with hooks for custom development
  • Rule-Based Targeting – Apply extensions to specific products, categories, or tags
  • Comprehensive Styling – Full design control with responsive settings
  • Shortcode Support – Manual placement options for page builders

Perfect For

  • eCommerce stores looking to increase conversion rates
  • Businesses launching pre-order campaigns
  • Stores needing trust and credibility signals
  • Sites requiring GDPR/CCPA compliance
  • Anyone wanting to reduce plugin dependencies
  • Store owners focused on mobile optimization

Additional Information

For more information, updates, and premium support, visit softtent.com/managex.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL-2.0-or-later License.
sections.installation:
1. Upload softtent-managex to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Dashboard > ManageX to browse and enable extensions
  4. Configure individual extension settings
  5. Use rule-based targeting to apply extensions to specific products
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes, ManageX is built specifically for WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

How many extensions are included?

ManageX includes 18+ powerful extensions covering conversion optimization, marketing, product management, user experience, legal compliance, and social proof.

Can I use these extensions with my existing theme?

Yes, all extensions are designed to work seamlessly with any WordPress theme. Comprehensive styling options ensure perfect integration with your site’s design.

Do extensions work with variable products?

Yes, core extensions including Pre-Orders, Buy Now, Quick View, Product Badges, and all add-to-cart variations fully support WooCommerce variable products.

Can I target specific products or categories?

Most extensions include advanced rule-based targeting. Include or exclude products by category, tag, user role, or specific products for precise control.

Is this plugin translation ready?

Yes, ManageX follows WordPress internationalization standards and can be translated using .mo/.po files.

Will this slow down my site?

ManageX is performance-optimized with clean, efficient code. Extensions load only when enabled, minimizing impact on page load times.

Do extensions support page builders?

Yes, most extensions include shortcode support for manual placement with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and other page builders.

Can I customize the appearance?

Every extension includes comprehensive styling options with responsive controls for colors, typography, spacing, borders, positioning, and hover states.

Is there documentation available?

Visit softtent.com/managex for comprehensive documentation, tutorials, and support.

Need help?

Contact our support team at contact@softtent.com
